scenes.label: Winter dog walks
scenes.vo: Dark by half four? Three ways to be seen on the dog walk.

scenes: A short, strong lead on a well-fitting collar whenever you're near traffic.

scenes.vo: One. Near roads, keep them on a short, strong lead, on a collar that fits well.

scenes: A hi-vis dog coat, or an LED collar or tag, so drivers can see you both.

scenes.vo: Two. Light them up. A hi-vis coat, or an LED collar or tag, so drivers can see you both.

scenes: Teach a sit and wait at the kerb before you cross.

scenes.vo: Three. Sit, wait, then walk. Teach it at the kerb before you cross.

scenes: What time is your dog's last walk?

scenes.vo: What time's your dog's last walk? Tell us in the comments. And MyGroom's free, link in bio.
